query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.specialties, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT a.therapyType ORDER BY a.therapyType SEPARATOR ', ') as therapy_types_used, COUNT(a.id) as total_appointments FROM users u LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.therapistUserId = u.id WHERE u.role IN ('therapist', 'admin') GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.specialties ORDER BY u.name;
